name: Quartermaster

features.text: Configure category/item storage rules, priorities, presets and whole-furniture sections.
Sort inventory, containers, rooms, buildings and eligible floor items; shopping demands and Dibs lists.
Rooms integration and supply API used by Auto Clean.
physical shareable shopping papers and held-list HUD; paper supply inspections and ledger CDs.
Powered Windows'93 desktop, CD Writer and QUARTERMASTER.EXE; ledger freshness requirements for room/building work.
Carry grouping, progress, vehicle/trailer cargo and nested bags; optional Dangerous Load and extra carry allowance.
Sparse container/Whole/preset/room allocation profiles and percentage UI; bounded shadow accounting and reservation primitives. Enforcement and live role routing disabled.

Designated-room-only UI/server scopes with native building scope; retired native profiles stay dormant even through aliases. No-profile Shadow comparisons preserve ordinary native eligibility and capacity checks.

Original bulky CRT art with softer shading and pixel icons; retained drive/writer/ledger tasks, minimize/restore, app switching, per-app close and Show Desktop. Cached ledger resume revalidates through existing server reads; presentation only. Digital ledger table with separate item/quantity/location columns, selected-entry details and preserved refresh selection/scroll.

Ruled paper clipboard with three-column ledger and page-turn controls. Server limits live computer statistics and automatic freshness to the exact recorded building; off-site/safehouse-wide CDs retain ordinary historical access. Supply Sheet creation requires a reusable vanilla clipboard and writing implement; paper/notebook is consumed.

limits: Native SP/dedicated NOT TESTED for 0.18.0-dev.8; G7/stable G8 BLOCKED. Advisory allocation does not override native transfer grants. Earlier runtime evidence is historical.

relations.text: Designated UUID geometry, metadata and independent action permissions; current storageScopes/roomDesignations contracts for advisory room profiles.
